findings.title: 권한이 좁은 Export 계정은 트리거/루틴/이벤트(와 권한 없는 테이블)를 조용히 빼고 strict_export=true(완전한 덤프)로 표시한다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/schema.rs:448-471: 트리거·루틴·이벤트 감지가 information_schema.triggers/routines/events에만 의존하는데, MySQL은 이 결과를 계정 권한으로 거른다(TRIGGER / SHOW_ROUTINE·CREATE ROUTINE·EXECUTE / EVENT 권한이 필요). migration_core/src/dump.rs:919의 dump_scope_refusal은 이 목록으로만 거부 여부를 정한다. docs/export_import_policy.md:235 'Triggers on an exported table: Refused before export'와 다르다. 실측(8.4·8.0 동일): GRANT SELECT, LOCK TABLES ON tfpriv_obj.* 계정으로 information_schema를 조회하면 triggers 0 / routines 0 / events 0, root는 1/1/1. dump.run 결과: root와 DB 범위 ALL 계정은 'dump.run refused: ... trigger:t1:trg_t1_ai, routine:p_noop, event:ev_noop'. SELECT+LOCK TABLES 계정은 {"success":true,"strict_export":true} 이고 manifest_warnings=[] 이다. 테이블 단위 GRANT SELECT ON tfpriv_src.parent 계정으로 전체 export하면 tables=['parent']만 담기고(child·view 누락) 여전히 strict_export=True, 경고 없음.
findings.scenario: 운영 DB에서 읽기 전용 계정(SELECT[, LOCK TABLES])으로 전체 Export를 하면 트리거·프로시저·이벤트가 있어도 거부 대화상자가 뜨지 않는다. 덤프는 '완전'으로 표시되고, Import 쪽도 이 덤프를 strict로 받아들인다. 사용자는 백업이 완전하다고 믿지만 트리거·루틴·이벤트(테이블 단위 권한이면 테이블까지)가 없다. 해결 방향: 해당 권한이 있는지 확인하고(SHOW GRANTS 또는 SHOW_ROUTINE/TRIGGER/EVENT 보유 여부), 없으면 strict_export=false와 '이 계정 권한으로는 트리거/루틴/이벤트를 확인할 수 없음' 경고를 남기거나 allow_incomplete 없이는 거부한다.

findings.title: 기본 Import 모드(안전 복원)와 덮어쓰기는 DB 범위 계정에서 항상 실패하는데, UI는 필요 권한을 알려주지 않는다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/safe_restore.rs:330-346과 483-503: 대상 DB가 이미 있으면 CREATE DATABASE `tf_restore_<nanos>_<pid>`가 필수다. migration_core/src/safe_promote_mysql.rs:121-127(prove_metadata_visibility: 전역 SELECT/SHOW VIEW/PROCESS 필요), :768과 :1036-1045(tf_backup_/tf_promote_ DB 생성). src/ui/dialogs/db_import_dialog.py:646-660의 모드 설명에는 권한 언급이 없고, :1765는 원시 메시지를 그대로 보여준다. 권한 검사는 전체 청크 검증(safe_restore.rs:233) 뒤에야 일어난다. 실측(8.0·8.4): GRANT ALL ON tfpriv_tgt.* 계정의 safe 결과는 'safe candidate creation failed (existing namespaces are never reused): MySqlError { ERROR 1044 (42000): Access denied for user 'tfpriv_dbonly'@'%' to database 'tf_restore_1791866871207938321_1' }', status=failed_original_untouched. ALL ON `tf\_restore\_%`.*를 추가하면 safe는 성공하지만 promote plan은 blocked이고 'guarded promotion requires proven direct global SELECT, SHOW VIEW and PROCESS visibility ...'가 나온다. SELECT,SHOW VIEW,PROCESS ON *.*와 ALL ON tf\_backup\_%/tf\_promote\_%까지 주면 status=promoted.
findings.scenario: 오늘 max_error_count 사고와 같은 종류의 DB 범위 로컬/스테이징 계정으로 기본값(안전 복원) 그대로 Import하면, 덤프 전체 검증을 기다린 뒤 'Access denied ... tf_restore_...' 원시 오류로 실패한다(원본은 안전함). 덮어쓰기도 같다. 이런 계정으로 실제 동작하는 모드는 사용자 규칙(1·2·3)을 따르는 '고급: 전체 교체/완전 재생성'과 '데이터 추가'뿐이다. 해결 방향: 시작 전에 권한을 확인해 필요 권한(CREATE on tf_restore_%, 덮어쓰기는 전역 SELECT/SHOW VIEW/PROCESS와 tf_backup_/tf_promote_)을 안내하거나 교체 모드를 제안한다.

findings.title: REFERENCES 권한 없는 계정: DDL 사전 검증을 통과한 뒤 모든 테이블을 교체하고 나서 FK 단계에서 실패한다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/import.rs:517-537 probe_import_ddl는 FK 없는 CREATE TABLE만 시험한다. :419-430은 테이블마다 DROP 후 CREATE하고 적재한다. migration_core/src/ddl.rs:263-303 apply_post_load_ddl은 모든 적재가 끝난 뒤에 ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT FOREIGN KEY를 실행한다. 실측(8.4): GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, CREATE, DROP, ALTER, INDEX ON tfpriv_tgt.* 계정으로 replace하면 'post_load_validation_failed: post-load DDL failed while executing ALTER TABLE `child` ADD CONSTRAINT `fk_child_parent` ... ERROR 1142 (42000): REFERENCES command denied to user 'tfpriv_app'@'[ip-address]' for table 'tfpriv_tgt.parent''. 이후 대상 상태: parent 2행, child 2행이 교체됐고 REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS 0건, 뷰 v_parent 없음.
findings.scenario: 흔한 앱 계정(REFERENCES·CREATE VIEW 없음)으로 '전체 교체'를 실행하면 사전 검증이 통과하고, 선택한 모든 테이블이 DROP→재생성→적재된다. 그다음에야 FK 생성이 거부되어 대상 전체에 FK가 없고 뷰도 없는 상태로 '실패'한다. 'mysqldump 기준: 첫 오류에서 멈추고 피해는 그 테이블 하나'를 위반한다. 해결 방향: preflight probe에 FK(부모+자식 probe 쌍)와 CREATE VIEW를 포함하거나 REFERENCES/CREATE VIEW 권한을 미리 확인한다.

findings.title: SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN 없는 계정은 legacy ENUM '' 데이터를 Import하지 못하고, 교체된 테이블이 빈 채로 남는다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/adapters.rs:789-799 raise_mysql_max_error_count는 1227을 무시해 max_error_count가 1024로 남는다(ponytail 주석이 이 상한을 인지하고 있음). 그런데 migration_core/src/import.rs:1878-1881 enum_warning_batch_rows와 :1825의 LOAD DATA 분할 기준은 MYSQL_IMPORT_MAX_WARNINGS=65535(import.rs:24)를 전제로 한다. :1917-1921은 SHOW COUNT(*) WARNINGS 값과 SHOW WARNINGS 행 수가 다르면 거부한다. 실측(8.4): ENUM('x','y') 3열에 '' 값 600행. DB 범위 ALL 계정의 replace 결과는 'mysql insert fallback error for table e3 chunk 1: import data validation failed: 1500 MySQL warnings: 1265: Data truncated for column 'a' at row 1; ...'이고 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tfpriv_tgt.e3 = 0. 같은 덤프를 root로 넣으면 Import completed, 600행.
findings.scenario: 오래된 비strict 운영 데이터(ENUM 빈값)를 DB 범위 계정으로 교체 Import하면, INSERT 폴백에서는 ENUM 3열 이상, LOAD DATA 경로에서는 청크당 1024셀 초과일 때 하드 실패한다. 해당 테이블은 DROP 후 빈 상태로 남는다. v2.17.1은 SET 문 실패만 고쳤고 상한 자체는 남아 있다. 해결 방향: raise 시도 뒤 @@max_error_count를 읽어 배치 행 수와 분할 기준을 계산한다.

findings.title: max_user_connections가 제한된 계정에서 병렬 Export가 원시 1226 오류로 실패하고 대안 안내가 없다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/dump.rs:138-142는 coordinator·control·워커 N개 연결을 연다. dump.rs:113-121 mysql_parallel_privilege_error는 1044/1045/1142/1227만 권한 마커로 바꾼다. 실측(8.4, MAX_USER_CONNECTIONS 3, threads 4): 'mysql connection error: MySqlError { ERROR 1226 (42000): User 'tfpriv_ro' has exceeded the 'max_user_connections' resource (current value: 3) }'. 같은 계정으로 single_connection은 성공.
findings.scenario: 연결 수가 제한된 공유/매니지드 계정으로 기본 병렬 Export를 하면 바로 실패하고, Export 대화상자의 권한 질문(단일 연결로 계속)도 뜨지 않는다. 사용자가 스레드 수를 낮추거나 단일 연결을 직접 골라야 한다는 걸 알 수 없다.

findings.title: parallel_strict: RELOAD만 있는 계정은 서버 전체 FTWRL을 잡은 뒤에야 BACKUP_ADMIN 부족으로 실패한다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/dump.rs:160-191: FLUSH TABLES WITH READ LOCK을 먼저 잡고, 워커 스냅샷을 연 다음 LOCK INSTANCE FOR BACKUP을 시도한다. 실측(8.0·8.4, GRANT RELOAD ON *.*와 SELECT, LOCK TABLES ON db.*): 'MYSQL_PARALLEL_SNAPSHOT_PRIVILEGE_REQUIRED:BACKUP_ADMIN:ERROR 1227 (42000): Access denied; you need (at least one of) the BACKUP_ADMIN privilege(s) for this operation'. 실패 전에 FTWRL이 실제로 획득됐다.
findings.scenario: RELOAD는 있고 BACKUP_ADMIN은 없는 계정으로 Export를 시작할 때마다 서버 전체 쓰기가 짧게(최대 2초 대기 + 워커 스냅샷 시간) 막혔다가 실패한다. 이후 대화상자에서 테이블 락으로 재시도하는 흐름은 정상이다. BACKUP_ADMIN을 먼저 확인하거나 LOCK INSTANCE FOR BACKUP을 먼저 실행하면 피할 수 있다.

findings.title: 데이터 추가(merge): 대상에 같은 뷰가 이미 있으면 1050으로 'partial/실패' 처리된다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/import.rs:1038-1042: 기존 뷰 DROP은 replace/recreate일 때만 한다. 실측(8.4, DB 범위 계정): merge 결과는 status=partial, success=false, views_failed=[{'name':'v_parent','error':'... ERROR 1050 (42S01): Table 'v_parent' already exists'}]. 테이블 데이터는 커밋됨.
findings.scenario: 같은 덤프로 교체 Import를 한 대상에 데이터 추가 Import를 하면, 행은 모두 들어갔는데 결과는 '실패'로 표시된다. 권한 문제는 아니지만 모드 혼란을 키운다.

findings.title: Export 스냅샷 모드별 권한 요구와 강등은 문서대로 동작한다
findings.evidence: 실측(8.0·8.4): SELECT+LOCK TABLES 계정의 parallel_strict는 'MYSQL_PARALLEL_SNAPSHOT_PRIVILEGE_REQUIRED:FLUSH_TABLES_OR_RELOAD:ERROR 1227 ... RELOAD or FLUSH_TABLES' 마커를 낸다(dump.rs:166-176, 대화상자 db_export_dialog.py:1348-1356). parallel_table_lock은 같은 계정으로 성공하고(dump.rs:79-87), unsynchronized·no_backup_lock·single_connection은 SELECT만 있으면 성공한다. SHOW VIEW가 없으면 'View definitions could not be collected: ... ERROR 1142 SHOW VIEW command denied' 경고와 strict_export=false로 강등된다(dump.rs:735-750). 다른 세션이 WRITE 락을 잡은 상태에서 table_lock 모드는 'could not acquire table read locks within 2 seconds: ERROR 1205'로 안전하게 실패한다. KILL QUERY는 자기 연결 대상이라 추가 권한이 필요 없다.
findings.scenario: 권한이 없을 때 원시 오류 대신 마커와 대화상자로 다음 모드를 안내하고, 실패하더라도 덤프 파일이 '완전'으로 잘못 기록되지 않는다(위 트리거·루틴·이벤트 가시성 문제는 예외).

findings.title: DB 범위 계정의 교체/재생성/추가 Import는 세션 권한 요구 없이 동작하고 규칙 1·2·3을 지킨다
findings.evidence: migration_core/src/import.rs:1495-1523의 세션 SET(sql_mode, foreign_key_checks, unique_checks, default_storage_engine, lc_messages, net_read/write_timeout, wait_timeout)은 DB 범위 계정에서 모두 통과한다. max_error_count 1227은 adapters.rs:795-799가 무시한다. local_infile temporary_global은 'MySQL local_infile temporary enable failed: ... ERROR 1227 ... SUPER or SYSTEM_VARIABLES_ADMIN ...; using safe Rust INSERT fallback'으로 처리된다(import.rs:1314-1330; UI는 기본값 fallback만 사용). 뷰는 DEFINER를 제거해 생성하므로 DEFINER=tfpriv_dbonly@%, SQL SECURITY INVOKER가 유지되고 SET_USER_ID가 필요 없다. replace/recreate 결과: parent·child는 덤프 구조와 데이터로 교체되고 덤프에 없는 keep_me는 미변경. 8.0·8.4 동일.
findings.scenario: DB 범위 권한만 있는 계정에서 사용자 규칙(1 덮어씀, 2 생성, 3 덤프 밖 테이블 미변경)을 지키는 모드는 '고급: 전체 교체/완전 재생성'뿐이고 실제로 동작한다. 단 REFERENCES 누락과 legacy ENUM 상한은 위 bug 항목 참고. PostgreSQL 경로는 이번 렌즈에서 라이브 검증하지 않았다.

verdicts.title: 권한이 좁은 Export 계정은 트리거/루틴/이벤트(와 권한 없는 테이블)를 조용히 빼고 strict_export=true(완전한 덤프)로 표시한다

verdict.reasoning:
I read the code and the claim holds. I did not repeat the live test; the auditor's numbers match what the code does with MySQL's documented information_schema filtering.

1. Detection uses filtered views only (migration_core/src/schema.rs:449-471). Triggers, routines and events come only from information_schema.triggers, routines and events. MySQL filters these by privilege: TRIGGER on the table; DEFINER, SHOW_ROUTINE, global SELECT, or CREATE/ALTER ROUTINE/EXECUTE; EVENT. The table list is also filtered: it comes from information_schema.tables (ddl.rs:1150, via inspect_generic). There is no SHOW GRANTS check or visibility check anywhere on the export path. A grep of dump.rs, schema.rs and src/*.py finds none.

2. The refusal only sees what was detected (dump.rs:913-927). Its object list is inspection.unsupported_objects plus non-transactional tables. A full export means selected_tables is empty (dump.rs:891), and that runs on whatever tables were visible. Hidden tables, triggers, routines and events produce no entries, so nothing is refused.

3. strict_export stays true (dump.rs:764-775). It is set false only when export_warnings (from detected objects) or a view-collection error exists. A restricted account produces neither.

4. Import also stays quiet (import.rs:106-122). source_dump_warnings warns only when !manifest.strict_export.

5. The project knows about this risk elsewhere. safe_promote_mysql.rs:121-128 (prove_metadata_visibility) runs SHOW GRANTS FOR CURRENT_USER and refuses cutover without global SELECT, SHOW VIEW and PROCESS. Its error says: "database-scoped permissions cannot certify external dependencies". docs/export_import_policy.md:75-76 says the same for promotion. Export has no such guard.

6. The docs do not cover this case. Policy line 235 says triggers are "Refused before export". The disclaimer at line 252 is about object types the inspection does not detect at all (partitioning, extensions), not objects that privileges hide.

7. No test covers it. The live tests that create restricted accounts (live_export_contract.rs:116, 352-354) never combine one with triggers, routines or events.

There is no handling to refute the claim, so it is real. It is a bug, not a rule_gap: a dump marked complete can be silently missing objects. PostgreSQL probably has the same gap, though I did not verify it live. schema.rs:678 also reads information_schema.triggers, which in PostgreSQL shows only triggers on tables the user owns or holds a non-SELECT privilege on.
verdict.corrected_claim: Confirmed bug, with the scope stated precisely. In MySQL, dump.run decides what to refuse using only information_schema (triggers, routines, events, tables, views; schema.rs:449-471, ddl.rs:1150), and the account's privileges filter all of these. It never checks whether the account can see all metadata. The only such check, prove_metadata_visibility in safe_promote_mysql.rs:121-128, runs only on promote. So a SELECT[+LOCK TABLES] account (DB-scoped or table-scoped) gets no refusal (dump.rs:919). A full export then silently leaves out triggers, routines and events it cannot see; with a table-level grant it also leaves out tables and views. The manifest still says strict_export=true with no manifest_warnings (dump.rs:764-775), and import adds no 'not strict' warning (import.rs:116). This contradicts docs/export_import_policy.md:235. Global SELECT or SHOW_ROUTINE reveals routines, and TRIGGER reveals triggers, so only accounts without those privileges are affected. PostgreSQL triggers (schema.rs:678) are probably affected the same way for SELECT-only roles; not live-verified. Suggested fix, mirroring the promote guard: before refusing, confirm metadata visibility through SHOW GRANTS (or the specific TRIGGER/EVENT/SHOW_ROUTINE privileges). If it cannot be confirmed, refuse without allow_incomplete, or set strict_export=false and add a persistent 'metadata visibility not proven for this account' warning.

verdicts.title: REFERENCES 권한 없는 계정: DDL 사전 검증을 통과한 뒤 모든 테이블을 교체하고 나서 FK 단계에서 실패한다

verdict.reasoning:
I read the code to check the claim, and it holds. probe_import_ddl (migration_core/src/import.rs:517-537) creates and drops a probe copy of each table using generate_table_ddl. That DDL has no FK clauses: FKs are emitted only by generate_post_data_ddl as `ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... FOREIGN KEY ... REFERENCES` (ddl.rs:187-214). So the preflight never uses the REFERENCES privilege.

In replace/recreate mode the loop at import.rs:419-430 runs replace_target_table (DROP), then create_new_table, then loads rows, one table at a time. Only after every table is loaded does finalize_dump_import call apply_post_load_ddl (import.rs:875-883, ddl.rs:263-303), and that is where the FK ALTERs run. Neither import.rs nor the Python import path (rust_dump_exporter.py, db_import_dialog.py, rust_dump_worker.py) checks privileges first. The only privilege handling I found is the export parallel-snapshot marker. docs/current_status.md does not track a REFERENCES-denied case.

The result is what the auditor measured. An account without REFERENCES passes the preflight, every selected table is dropped, recreated and loaded, and then ADD FOREIGN KEY fails as post_load_validation_failed. This breaks the mysqldump baseline. mysqldump puts FKs inline in CREATE TABLE, so it would stop at the first child table.

Some details are overstated or wrong:
(a) The missing view is not a separate CREATE VIEW failure. apply_post_load_ddl returns early through `?` (import.rs:883), so import_views (import.rs:903-913) never runs.
(b) View failures are non-fatal by design (a partial result with data committed, import.rs:900-901). A CREATE VIEW privilege check is a lower-priority UX addition, not part of this bug.
(c) Data and secondary indexes are restored correctly. Indexes run before FKs in post-data DDL. The damage is FK constraints missing on every replaced table, views not restored, and a failed status. No rows are lost.
(d) The same gap covers other post-load DDL that is never probed: non-unique CREATE INDEX on MySQL (INDEX privilege; ddl.rs:156 skips only unique keys) and PostgreSQL FK/COMMENT statements.
verdict.corrected_claim:
This is a real bug in replace/recreate mode. The DDL preflight (import.rs:517-537) only probes CREATE TABLE without FKs. FKs and non-unique MySQL indexes are added only after every table has been dropped, recreated and loaded (import.rs:419-430, then finalize_dump_import at import.rs:883, which calls apply_post_load_ddl at ddl.rs:263-303). Nothing checks REFERENCES or INDEX privileges beforehand. So an account without REFERENCES passes the preflight and gets all selected tables replaced, data and indexes included. It then fails with post_load_validation_failed and leaves every replaced table without FK constraints. This breaks the "stop at the first error, only that table is damaged" baseline.

Corrections to the claim:
- Views are missing because the post-load error returns before import_views runs (import.rs:883 vs 903). It is not a separate CREATE VIEW denial.
- View failures are non-fatal by design, so a CREATE VIEW check is optional UX hardening.
- No rows are lost; the damage is missing FKs and views plus a failed status.
- The fix: add FK probes (a parent and child probe pair) and a post-load index probe to probe_import_ddl, or check REFERENCES and INDEX privileges before the first DROP. The same gap applies to PostgreSQL REFERENCES.

verdicts.title: SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN 없는 계정은 legacy ENUM '' 데이터를 Import하지 못하고, 교체된 테이블이 빈 채로 남는다

verdict.reasoning:
I could not refute it. The code shows the mechanism, and the 1500-warning error in the report is exactly what the code produces for 600 rows with 3 ENUM columns.

1. migration_core/src/adapters.rs:795-799: `raise_mysql_max_error_count` ignores ERROR 1227, so the session stays at the server default of 1024 SHOW WARNINGS rows. Lines 793-794 carry a ponytail comment that already admits the gap: "a restricted account refuses a chunk with more than 1024 expected legacy ENUM-zero warnings". So this is a deferred known limit, not something that is handled.
2. The batch and split sizes still assume 65535 warnings:
   - import.rs:24 sets `MYSQL_IMPORT_MAX_WARNINGS=65_535`.
   - import.rs:1878-1881: `enum_warning_batch_rows` = min(500, 65535/legacy_enum_cols). With 3 columns that is 500 rows, which can mean 1500 warnings.
   - The TSV INSERT fallback batches at that size (import.rs:1611-1625).
   - LOAD DATA only splits a chunk when it has more than 65535 cells (import.rs:1825).
   - The JSONL / binary-column INSERT path at import.rs:821-829 also runs the whole chunk as one INSERT unless it has more than 65535 cells.
3. import.rs:1919-1921: `only_expected_enum_zero_warnings` returns false when SHOW COUNT(*) WARNINGS differs from the number of SHOW WARNINGS rows. execute_mysql_import_statement (import.rs:1949-1956) then returns "import data validation failed: {warnings} MySQL warnings: ..." and rolls back that statement. For 600 rows with 3 '' ENUM columns, the first 500-row batch gives 1500 warnings, which matches the reported text.
4. In replace/recreate, replace_target_table runs DROP TABLE (import.rs:419-424, 628) before the load, and the load error ends the import (import.rs:432 `?`). The table is left without its data.
5. Nothing reads @@max_error_count anywhere (grep). The repo's evidence that the SET fails for a database-scoped account is the live test at live_import_policy.rs:230 and the TF-STATUS-175 row. The legacy ENUM-zero live test (live_import_policy.rs:118-150) runs only as root, so no test covers this case.

Reachability: the code deliberately supports legacy ENUM-zero data, TF-STATUS-175 came from a real database-scoped local account, and MySQL 8 has local_infile OFF by default, so the default policy takes the INSERT-fallback path (import.rs:1126-1135, 1270).

Parts of the claim that are inexact:
- "ENUM 3열 이상" is necessary but not sufficient. The real condition is more than 1024 '' cells in one statement.
- The JSONL / binary-column path is missing from the claim.
- "빈 상태" should say "empty, or partly loaded".
verdict.corrected_claim:
The claim is real; the details below are corrected. On MySQL 8.0/8.4, an account without SESSION_VARIABLES_ADMIN keeps max_error_count=1024. raise_mysql_max_error_count ignores ERROR 1227 (adapters.rs:795-799, and its ponytail comment admits the limit). The import code still sizes its batches for 65535 warnings (import.rs:24). Any single import statement with more than 1024 legacy ENUM '' cells is therefore refused with "import data validation failed: N MySQL warnings", because SHOW COUNT(*) WARNINGS no longer matches the SHOW WARNINGS rows (import.rs:1919-1921, 1949-1956). The same dump imports fine as root. The threshold is cells per statement, not a column count:
(a) TSV INSERT fallback, the default when local_infile is OFF: per 500-row batch (or smaller under the 4 MB cap). This needs at least 3 legacy ENUM columns with '' in the same batch, e.g. 3 columns x 342 rows or more (import.rs:1611-1625, 1878-1881).
(b) LOAD DATA with local_infile ON: more than 1024 '' cells in one dump chunk, even with one ENUM column. The split happens only above 65535 cells (import.rs:1825).
(c) JSONL or binary-column tables: the whole chunk is one INSERT, so the same per-chunk limit applies (import.rs:819-829).

In replace/recreate the target table is dropped before loading (import.rs:419-424, 628). The failing statement rolls back and the import stops, so that table is left empty, or holding only the batches/chunks already committed. Tables not yet reached keep their data, which is the same damage scope as mysqldump. Merge mode keeps the table but stops partway. The error text does not mention max_error_count or privileges.

Fix direction stands: after the raise attempt, read @@max_error_count and use it in enum_warning_batch_rows and in the LOAD DATA / JSONL split threshold. Add a live test that imports more than 1024 ENUM-zero cells with a database-scoped account.
